changelog: **Service worker precache holds only entries it can serve (v59.98):** index.html requests the classic scripts as `./js/<name>.js?v=<version>` and `cache.match` compares the query string, so the three query-less `./js/aio-*.js` precache entries never answered a request, online or offline. They were removed from `CRITICAL_SHELL_ASSETS` (the versioned shell branch already stores each script under its requested URL on first fetch), and `ci-service-worker-cache-policy-check` now installs the worker with a real `addAll`, goes offline and requests every precached page script exactly as index.html writes it.
note: v59.98: sw.js drops three never-served precache entries; behavioural offline check added
